# API.Bible

API.Bible allows developers to integrate Scripture content into their applications or websites for non-commercial purposes.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/api-bible/.

## Actions

- **Get All Books** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all books in the bible.
- **Get Bible by ID** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific bible version by its id.
- **Get Section** (read-only): Retrieve detailed content for a single section by id.
- **Get Sections** (read-only): Retrieve a list of sections for a specific book in a bible version.
- **Get Supported Bible Versions** (read-only): Retrieve supported bible versions.
- **Search Verses** (read-only): Search for verses containing a specified query within a version.
